title: Torch

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Torch is a utility club. Its primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. It does not have a secondary attack.
It provides light. When equipped, it has the same effect as a fire, scaring off Necks, untamed Boars, Greylings and Greydwarfs.
It can be equipped in both main and off-hand.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The player starts the game with a torch.
• The torch passively loses durability when equipped and will stay lit for a maximum of 10 minutes (night lasts for nine minutes).
• Torches cannot be repaired and will simply disappear when their durability reaches 0%.
• Cannot be placed on an Item Stand.
• Despite its description, the torch does not provide the player with warmth.
